purpose: Fast windowed PBT with cool-down probes (planning/window_probe.py: each decision ranks the members on a copy trained a quarter epoch at 0.1 x its LR), on 800k (sel1m_fast_pbt_probe) and on 8M (sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt_probe), seed 12345, selected on sel1m_tail. Fixed before training. The probe settings (0.1 x LR, a quarter epoch) were chosen after the 8M result of holdout_sel1m_train8m_v1 and are not tuned. References: standard ParT and fast PBT without probes of the same training set and seed. Primary comparisons: probe PBT against standard ParT on each training set. Secondary: probe PBT against PBT without probes.
